parts.text: $AAPL Q4 FY26 (preliminary): revenue $114.5B, +12% Y/Y, driven by September quarter records for iPhone and Services. Operating margin 31.1%. #earnings #tech

$EQH Q3 2026 (preliminary): Revenue was $3.9B, up 168% Y/Y, driven by positive organic growth and net inflows across all businesses. Operating margin stood at 35.8%. The Corebridge merger remains on track to close by year-end. #earnings #insurance
$WRB Q3 2026: revenue $3.7B, -1% Y/Y, as commercial property and casualty insurance operations saw slightly lower volumes. Operating margin 15.4%. #earnings #insurance

$CE Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.6B, +6% Y/Y, driven by pricing favorability in the Acetyl Chain. Operating margin 7.7% as the company raised its full-year free cash flow outlook. #earnings #materials
